items.label: CREATE VERTICAL STORAGE SPACE
items.value: Say goodbye to cluttered countertops and limited floor space! This over-the-toilet bathroom cabinet utilizes the unused area above your toilet, offering generous storage capacity without taking up additional room. Featuring 3 mesh shelves, a toilet paper holder, and 5 versatile hooks, it's ideal for organizing bathroom accessories, towels, bathrobes, or small baskets, keeping essentials neatly arranged and easily accessible.

items.label: PREMIUM CARBON STEEL
items.value: Crafted from high-quality carbon steel, this sturdy bathroom storage rack can support heavy loads without bending or breaking. Its waterproof and rustproof coating ensures reliable performance in humid environments like bathrooms and laundry rooms. It is designed to withstand daily wear and tear for long-term use. Besides, this bathroom decor is easy to maintain by wiping with a damp cloth.

items.label: NO MORE WOBBLING
items.value: Forget about wobbling or instability! This bathroom organizer and storage rack boasts a sturdy trapezoidal design, 2 wall-fixing kits for extra security, and 4 adjustable leveling feet to maintain stability on uneven surfaces. Whether you're storing heavy items or delicate essentials, rest assured that everything on the rack stays safe and secure without the risk of tipping.

items.label: EASY TO ASSEMBLE
items.value: No need to worry about installation! Our over-the-toilet storage rack comes with a complete accessory kit and clear, step-by-step instructions. To make it even easier, we've included a helpful installation video.This bathroom shelf is an ideal bathroom organizer and storage solution.And it has Optional Screw Holes：Freely install the bottom tube to the upper or lower screw holes based on the water supply valve's position.

items.label: DECORATE YOUR HOME
items.value: More than a simple bathroom shelf, this versatile and stylish metal rack effortlessly adapts to any space for extra storage. Use it in your living room for books and decorations, on the balcony to display plants, or in the laundry room over the washer for detergents and cleaning essentials. Its modern design complements any décor, combining practicality with elegance to elevate your home.
